_about: DRAFT host limits of OpenSWOS (SDL + Amiga m68k), from its sources and docs (2026-10-26): to confirm with the OpenSWOS maintainer. Encoding latin1 + the font extension's spare bytes (docs/FONTS.md CP_OVERRIDE: Œ 0x8C, Ÿ 0x9E, € 0x9D); charset = the stock font (A-Z, 0-9, punctuation, Ä Ö Ü) + the extended glyphs of bin/setup/glyphs.txt; team names 16 characters (teamName[17]); competition names 35 (competitionName[36]); 24 clubs per table (fixed pair tables, competitions-in-openswos §12); widths as the 1996 small font, 6 px for the added glyphs. The Amiga has more memory than the DOS exe, so the arena limit is higher.
